title: The Gauss linking integral on the 3-sphere and in hyperbolic 3-space
note: arXiv:math/0406276 (published under the title 'Electrodynamics and the Gauss linking integral on the 3-sphere and in hyperbolic 3-space', J. Math. Phys. 49, 023504). Supplies the H³ Gauss linking integral (Thm 1(3), kernel csch α), the H³ Biot--Savart operator (Thm 2(3)), and — the object the EM-linking attack needs — a fundamental solution of the H³ Laplacian, φ₀(α) = −coth(α)/4π (this preprint, §7 'Proof scheme for Theorem 2, formula (3)': (cosh α)φ(α) = φ₀(α), Δφ₀ = δ). The 108-page electrodynamics paper [deturck-gluck-electrodynamics2008] (library/0510388v1, §§2.5, 4.4, 4.6) normalises it as φ₀(α) = −(coth α − 1)/4π, which differs by the constant 1/4π and tends to 0 as α → ∞; that is the exact hyperbolic analogue of 1/r. Corrected 2026-11-21, bean qou-tk1r. Read in full 2026-08-01; findings and the two structural obstructions in docs/audits/2026-08-01-em-linking-reads-round1.md. Note there is NO interaction-energy formula, no compact-quotient theory, and no H³ Green's operator on vector fields (Thm 3 is S³-only). Uploaded library/0406276v1/
